24 PROGRAMMES · INTAKE JANUARY 2027

Home/Our programmes

Practical programmes for the trades of the future.

Vocational programmes lasting three to eighteen months, with a company internship, across three levels: from BEPC to post-bac. Each duration is adapted to the trade and the level targeted.

Learn today, work tomorrow.

THREE TRAINING LEVELS

From a first trade to specialisation.

The institute supports each learner according to their level: from vocational programmes open from BEPC level to advanced technical programmes.

0119 programmes

BEPC / Probatoire level

Vocational, qualifying programmes to learn a practical trade, open before the baccalaureate. Several prepare for the CQP. Beauty therapy and body careTiling and surface finishesDigital skills and AIAccounting and managementCare assistant See the programmes 023 programmes

Baccalaureate level

More technical programmes, for baccalaureate holders, leading to skilled jobs in digital technology and healthcare. Computer programmingMedical sales representative See the programmes 032 programmes

Post-baccalaureate level

RACINES D'AVENIRVocational Training Institute

A vocational training institute based in Yaoundé, Racines d'Avenir trains young people and adults for in-demand trades in construction, tailoring, beauty, services and digital technology.

Our mission: to train, support and place every learner, all the way to a job or a business of their own.
